value.statement: Pickup occurs at the DD House store (Venkat Nagar, Kakinada). Customers must collect their order from the store.
An Order ID and a PIN are generated upon order placement. The customer must provide these relevant order identification details at the store counter to collect their order.
If the customer informs the store early about a pickup delay, the store attempts to keep the item safe. If necessary and appropriate, a fresh item may be prepared when the customer arrives.
